label: Apple HomePod mini
description: Compact Siri smart speaker with a full-range driver and four-microphone array. 802.11n 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0 and a U1 chip for nearby handoff; no wired interface.
notes: Wireless only - 802.11n (Wi-Fi 4) on 2.4 and 5 GHz, no Ethernet, no PoE. 20 W adapter. Very chatty on mDNS/Bonjour; it will flood a lab's multicast group if IGMP snooping is off.
